_comment: Copy this to projects.json and fill in your projects. projects.json is gitignored. Each key is the name a caller uses (./ask.sh "fix vulns in <name>"). 'assets' are the Vanta vulnerable-asset names to pull findings for; run `vanta-findings <name>` to check they resolve. 'owners' lists everyone tagged (by Slack member id, U...) in every channel message. Optional: 'base_branch' pins the PR base instead of auto-detecting staging -> develop -> main, and 'base_branch_reason' says why.
